scripts.check-backend: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run --filter backend check
scripts.check-frontend: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run --filter frontend check
scripts.check-all: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run --filter backend check && pnpm run --filter frontend check
